en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the dining hall.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
I think you might be sick, Shuichi.

A lot of intense stuff did happen, so...
I think you should go rest in your room.

Great idea!
Let's drink some tea and have a chat!

I wanna know you better,
so this is perfect timing.

Ummm...
Is this a kind of training for detectives?

I don't think this will help me with my
piano performances, so I'll pass...

And since we're here, I'd prefer to
do funner activities...

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Kaede looks deep in thought...
